summary_bullets: Unblock paused design publishes that include driver phase sentinels
Restore paused design snapshots without depending on archive attributes
Preserve retryable pause markers and remove stale markers only after successful loads
commit_message:
Fix design pause resume recovery paths

Allow design pause publishes to stage the driver phase sentinels, restore paused snapshots with git ls-tree plus git show so export-ignore does not hide logs, and invert marker cleanup so retryable load failures keep the marker while successful loads delete it. Update the pause/resume docs, security notes, and regression harness coverage.
